name: Gemini
description: Gemini is Google's AI assistant, offered through the Gemini app and Google AI subscription plans for individuals, plus Business and Enterprise options.
features: Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas and Gems
Storage bundled with Google AI plans
useCases: Creating and editing files in a chat
strengths: A free plan with a Google account
Business and Enterprise seats are priced in USD per seat
limitations: Usage limits reset every 5 hours until a weekly limit is reached; numeric limits are not stated
Some features are limited to selected countries and some require users to be 18 or older

plans.name: Free
highlights: Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, Gems

plans.name: Google AI Plus
plans.note: Price shown in Pakistani rupees for Pakistan on 2026-10-29; the US dollar price was not captured

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.note: Price shown in Pakistani rupees for Pakistan on 2026-10-29; the US dollar price was not captured

plans.name: Google AI Ultra
highlights: 10,000 or 25,000 Google Flow credits by tier
plans.note: Rs 21,999 per month is the 5x tier price on gemini.google/subscriptions and one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans (both public, Pakistan). The signed-in Google One page (one.google.com/ai) shows AI Ultra as 'Starting at PKR 27,900 per month'. Google does not explain the difference on any page we read, so the amount is not settled; confirm at checkout

plans.name: Gemini Enterprise Business
plans.note: Shown as a starting price of $21 per seat per month, for up to 300 seats

plans.name: Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus
highlights: Up to 75 GiB pooled storage per seat
plans.note: Shown as a starting price of $30 per seat per month; contact sales

free.details: Free with a Google account: Flash-Lite model access, image generation and editing, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, Gems, limited Google Flow access and 15 GB storage. Numeric usage limits are not stated.

pricing.trial: A limited trial of Veo 3.1 Lite with AI Pro is mentioned; its length and limits are not stated.

api.summary: Google AI Studio is free to start, with paid tiers for higher limits. The Gemini platform is pay-as-you-go. Per-token rates were not shown on the page we read.

pricing.regional: Consumer prices are localised by country (shown here in Pakistani rupees), so the US price is not recorded. The signed-in Google One page (one.google.com/ai, read in Chrome on 2026-11-02) shows annual options: AI Plus Rs 14,000 per year (saves Rs 2,800) and AI Pro Rs 55,900 per year (saves Rs 11,300); AI Ultra is monthly billing only. Plan availability varies by country. Annual pricing was not on the public pages we read.
notes: Consumer plan prices differ by country. Check the official page for the price in your country.

verification.notes: Product active. gemini.google/subscriptions (Pakistan): Free Rs 0, Google AI Plus Rs 1,400, Google AI Pro Rs 5,600, Google AI Ultra Rs 21,999 (5x AI Pro usage) and a 20x tier at Rs 55,900 per month; Business tab (USD): Gemini Enterprise Business from $21 and Standard/Plus from $30 per seat per month. one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans (public, Chrome, Pakistan) matches it: Ultra 5x Rs 21,999 and 20x Rs 55,900 per month. The signed-in Google One page one.google.com/ai (Chrome, signed-in account, Pakistan) matches Plus Rs 1,400 and Pro Rs 5,600 per month and shows annual Plus Rs 14,000 and Pro Rs 55,900 per year, but shows AI Ultra as 'Starting at PKR 27,900 per month' (monthly billing only). No tax or VAT wording was found on that page, and Plus and Pro are identical across surfaces, so tax alone does not explain the gap. We could not find an official explanation (different plan, regional offer or outdated price), so the record stays partially verified and both Ultra figures are documented.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser (Personal, Business and Developer tabs read) and, on 2026-11-02, in the owner's real Chrome (Pakistan, Asia/Karachi): gemini.google/subscriptions, one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans and the signed-in one.google.com/ai page including its Annual toggle; no checkout or payment step was opened

profile.headline: Google's AI assistant for writing, learning, coding and creating

capabilities.title: Help with everyday writing and planning
capabilities.text: The Gemini page shows it drafting emails and brainstorming ideas for an upcoming event.

capabilities.title: Explain hard ideas
capabilities.text: It can simplify complex concepts and surface related insights about a topic or an image.

capabilities.title: Work through code
capabilities.text: The page shows it helping with coding tasks, including debugging a difficult problem.

capabilities.title: Plan and illustrate content
capabilities.text: It can draft an outline for something like a blog post and create images to illustrate it.

featureCards.name: Gemini Live
featureCards.text: Listed on the Gemini page as one of the app's features for talking with it.

featureCards.name: Image and video generation
featureCards.text: The Gemini page lists image generation and video generation among its capabilities.

featureCards.name: Music generation
featureCards.text: Music generation is named on the Gemini page as a creative feature.

featureCards.name: Deep Research
featureCards.text: Deep Research is one of the named features of the Gemini app.

featureCards.name: Google Search and extensions
featureCards.text: Gemini can use Google Search and extensions such as Workspace, Maps and YouTube, which you can turn on or off.

featureCards.name: Gems
featureCards.text: Customise Gemini with specific instructions so it acts as a subject-matter expert. The page says this was coming soon, so check that it is available to you.

audienceDetail.text: The page describes Gemini as a versatile tool for people who want to be more productive, more creative and more curious.
Students is one of the named areas on the Gemini page, for learning difficult concepts.
Coding help and debugging are among the example uses.

scenarios.title: Summarise a long research document
scenarios.text: Upload the document and ask for a summary; the page notes that file uploads are part of Gemini Advanced.

scenarios.title: Debug a difficult coding problem
scenarios.text: Describe the problem and ask Gemini to help you work through it.

scenarios.title: Plan a blog post
scenarios.text: Ask for an outline and for illustrations to go with it.

scenarios.title: Prepare for an event
scenarios.text: Brainstorm ideas and draft the emails that go with them.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Try Gemini button to get the mobile app, or open the web app at gemini.google.com/app.
Start with one of the example tasks, such as an email, an outline or a code question.
Decide whether Gemini may use Google Search and extensions such as Workspace, Maps and YouTube.
